item.title: Community Conversation Volunteer Shift
item.description:
Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: Houston Food Bank East Branch, 535 Portwall Street, Houston, TX, 77029, United States

Join a truly unique volunteer shift where neighbors, community leaders, and food bank staff come together to share experiences and bridge mutual understanding. The gathering is highly interactive and uses structured conversations to build stronger and more connected communities. Whether you join individually or as a group, this experience moves beyond food distribution to focus on lasting community impact! Register Here

item.title: Empty Bowls Houston at The Market at River Oaks District
item.description:
Sunday, August 23, 2026 at 11 AM

Location: The Market at River Oaks, 4444 Westheimer, Houston, TX, 77027, United States

Empty Bowls Houston will be at the The Market at River Oaks District Sunday, August 23 from 11 am to 3 pm at River Oaks District, 4444 Westheimer, 77027 Happy summer, friends! Empty Bowls Houston is happy to announce that we will be “popping up” at one of Houston’s newest farmers markets, The Market at River Oaks District! We will have a selection of bowls for sale and a live pottery demo on the potters’ wheel. Come shop for farm-fresh goodies and other local food products and, of course, our amazing bowls made by local artists to benefit Houston Food Bank!

From Houston Food Bank
